title: Tension in rope OA
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the tension F_T1 as 10 N from equilibrium of slider A.

title: Friction on E
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the kinetic friction force F_f5 between E and the ground as 5.2 N.

title: Applied force F
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the applied horizontal force F as 28 N.

title: Normal force chain
description: Important: Correctly builds the chain of normal forces from A down to E using vertical equilibrium for each block or group.

title: Horizontal equilibrium
description: Important: Applies horizontal force equilibrium correctly for each block, relating tensions and friction forces.

title: Friction law application
description: Important: Correctly applies the kinetic friction law (f = μN) for each interface using the appropriate normal force.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Reverses the direction of a friction force or tension in an equilibrium equation.

title: Normal force mistake
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for the weight of all blocks above when calculating a normal force between two specific blocks.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Shows consistent use of units (N, kg, m/s²) and trigonometric values (sin37°, cos37°).
